name: Dryberry Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from a 1960 MNRF transect survey (year from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 109.7 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour. Muskellunge confirmed (ARA + Broad-scale Monitoring); deep, cold (Secchi 6.3 m) shield lake.
